name: health_add_dependant
description: Protected. Request to add a newborn as a dependant (SH-03, SH-04). Needs the birth notification upload first. Only after reading back the name and date of birth and hearing a clear yes. Two-step: the first call changes nothing; after a clear yes, call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id.

dependant_name.description: The baby's name as the caller confirmed it

born_days_ago.description: How many days ago the baby was born, when the caller gives a relative day (0 today, 1 yesterday)

dependant_dob.description: Only if the caller gave a calendar date: YYYY-MM-DD

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
